title: Corpus precision unions exhaustive scope across layers
description:
`scoreCorpusPrecision` builds one `scopeFiles` set from every positive annotation regardless of layer, then walks every finding. `score.ts` buckets scope per `fixture::layer` via `scopeBucketKey`.

Consequence: a mention finding located in a file scoped for the components layer enters the precision denominator and can never match a component annotation, so it is counted a false positive. **Corpus precision is structurally deflated, not merely inconsistent.**

This is live in the build today — `corpus-precision.spec.ts` runs on a synthetic fixture, not a materialized repo, so it is in CI now. Worth fixing ahead of the rewrite so no interim number is cited from a scorer wrong in a known direction.

Startable now — independent of the gate rulings.
